scope: Base audit: returned frozen teacher1000 self predictions in four V scenes. Follow-up additionally reads their native observations and reconstructs the baseline frozen input embedding from its original seed. No optimizer update, trained-checkpoint forward, threshold selection, normalizer refit or T_test access. See deeper_analysis for the separately labeled oracle.
method: Residual directions use local north/east tangent approximation at base latitude and longitude shortest arc; reported MAE uses same spherical haversine radius 6371000m as repository. No model updates or calibration. Four V scenes only.

formula_notes.residual: prediction - position_base; longitude shortest arc; local N/E at base latitude for directions and variation
formula_notes.energy_fraction: 1 - total within-fragment squared residual / total squared residual; descriptive, not R-squared
formula_notes.regional_loss: Original FusionLoss in FP32; disjoint regional losses aggregated by per-attribute valid-point counts

conclusions: Inside-support degradation is source-dependent: 9001 worsens at every evaluable point; 9002 modestly improves. 9001/reference reuse limits denoising claims.
Position residual is nearly constant within each fragment; speed nearly constant across all queries. This is an output observation, not proof of the internal cause.
For 9002 inside support, required correction is itself predominantly a per-fragment translation; too-small amplitude and direction matter. Constant shape alone is not a failure proof there.
Outside support the required correction varies by kilometers while predicted residual varies by meters.

Loss reconstruction found no denominator mismatch. Regularizer has zero direct prediction-network gradient. Loss-value shares and differently initialized head norms do not establish gradient domination.
No post-hoc V fitting, hardcoded source offsets, forced zero residual or increased loss weight is justified by these four scenes alone. Model repair remains unvalidated.
caveats: Per-output derivatives do not include decoder/encoder Jacobians, pair cross reconstruction, BCE, optimizer or clipping. They cannot establish dominant training gradient.
Position and speed head started zero while course used Xavier; final row norm comparison is not proof of no training.
All variation results use same four scenes; 4,008 reference-supervised points, 86 fragments; 21 identities create correlated repetitions.
Actual 021 training gradient conflict/collapse chronology cannot be reconstructed without saved batch gradients/checkpoints.

software_verification.independent_review: passed; random independent count oracle over 100 populations, overall/ITSA/MSTSA

deeper_analysis.scope: Exploratory analysis on same V4 only; no neural training or trained-checkpoint inference. Frozen baseline embedding reconstructed from original initialization. Regular controls are input-only; the separately labeled alignment oracle uses V ground-truth identities, excludes held-out identity coordinates from offset estimation, and is not deployable performance. T_test remains sealed.

alignment_oracle.warning: ORACLE DIAGNOSTIC ONLY: uses ground-truth identity correspondences on V. Offset is estimated from other identities same-scene original observation interpolation only; NO reference or held-out identity coordinates enter estimation; the fixed original whole-scene query grid is retained. Not a deployable inference method or a claim of paper performance. References used solely to evaluate held-out source9002 inside support. All690 valid points retained; missing evidence would leave base unchanged.
alignment_oracle.mean_policy: For each scene/heldout identity, equally weight unique(other identity,query index) overlap slots; average signed-shortest-lon/latitude differences9001-9002. No scale/rotation/search/hyperparameters.

motion_controls.scope: four frozen V scenes, same 86 fragments/5504 query/4008 valid position points; exploratory CPU control, not trained or held-out result
motion_controls.prediction_rule: Keep frozen030 base inside. Outside, great-circle constant angular speed from adjacent endpoint pair OR first-last pair. Anchor at frozen030 endpoint base; no fitted hyperparameters, speed attribute or target used in prediction. All controls reported.

baseline_feature_geometry.scope: same four V scenes; CPU zero-update feature geometry; W reconstructed from original seed/config, not downloaded checkpoint

course.caveat: Oracle circular mean is a target dispersion statistic, never selected/evaluated as a deployable method; constant suitability may reflect unpredictable target noise.

verification.oracle: Independent raw-observation rebuild of all17 held-out identities: offsets exact; population39 fragments/690 points retained; all means reproduced.
verification.motion: Independent 3D sphere rotation check of both directions, dateline and high latitudes: maximum difference 5.7e-9m.
